coding.note: MVP is a released 406M BART-initialized model, not a novel backbone architecture. Claims consolidate repeated abstract/introduction statements. Supervised pre-training and prompt pre-training are coded TRAIN as the report's training contributions. Their comparisons are PARTIAL: backbone comparisons change training data/tokens, and pretrained versus random prompts changes training exposure. Dataset sources and cleaned sizes (Table 9), together with the disclosed temperature mixing rate T=2, support FULL disclosure. No total pre-training token count or hardware duration is reported; GPU count alone does not meet compute disclosure. Comparator provenance is mixed: cited BART/SOTA scores coexist with author-run baselines. Official GLUE website scoring is counted as external evaluation. No explicit technique renaming is identified.
